description: This file appears to be part of a Go-based GUI application that manages Wi-Fi channel configurations through a Fyne interface and interacts with underlying C code for network management. It includes functions for fetching, displaying, and setting Wi-Fi channels, along with related data structures and C interop code.

classes.name: classChannelMap
classes.description: Stores the capabilities (channel list) for a specific class of radio.

classes.name: channelConfig
classes.description: Stores previous configuration for a radio class including radio index, class, and channels.

methods.name: getChannelCapabilityFromTree
methods.description: Parses network tree to extract available channels per capability class and band.

methods.name: getConfiguredChannels
methods.description: Parses network tree to retrieve currently configured channels.

methods.name: updateChannelSection
methods.description: Updates the in-memory map of selected channels for a given band, class, and channel.

methods.name: resetBandToSingleClass
methods.description: Resets the selected channels for a band to only include a specific class.

methods.name: updateAnticipatedChannelPreference
methods.description: Updates the network tree with new channel preferences based on user selection.

methods.name: applyChannelConfig
methods.description: Executes a command to set the channels based on updated configuration in the network tree.

methods.name: mapchannelsToSlice
methods.description: Converts a map of channels to a string representation suitable for network tree updates.

methods.name: getKeyIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves integer value associated with a key from a network tree node.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an integer slice contains a specific value.

methods.name: periodicTimer
methods.description: Refreshes the Wi-Fi channel UI periodically.
